units.source_text: 至今我仍然觉得有些事情是不可思议的。

en.t: Even now, I still feel that some things are mysterious and hard to understand.

units.source_text: 本来我并没有波黑暗的思想所俘虏。

en.t: Originally, I had not been captured by a wave of dark thoughts.

units.source_text: 我所关心的、让我感到是个难题的，理应只是美的问题。

en.t: What concerned me, and what I felt to be a difficult problem, should only have been the question of beauty.

units.source_text: 但是，我并不认为战争作用于我，使我抱有黑暗的思想。

en.t: But I do not think that the war acted upon me and made me harbor dark thoughts.

units.source_text: 如果人只过度思虑美的问题，就会在这个世界上不知不觉间与最黑暗的思想碰撞。

en.t: If a person thinks too excessively only about the question of beauty, then in this world he will unknowingly collide with the darkest thoughts.
Human beings are probably born this way.
